> BNP Coorporation Sarl (BNPC) is a multiservice engineering company based in Yaoundé, Cameroon.
> Founded in 2023. Active in Yaoundé, Douala, Kribi and across Cameroon.
> Expertise: fire safety (SSIAP training, ERP audits), construction (BTP), water drilling,
> renewable energy (solar), drones & aerial imaging, naval repair, industrial cleaning.
> Contact: contact@bnp-coorporation.com, (+237) 6 55 01 09 19, BP 4219 Yaoundé.
> Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00-16:00, Sat 8:00-12:00. Languages: French (default), English.
